en.text: Why Chinese EVs Are Dominating Global Markets

China has become the world's largest automobile exporter, surpassing Japan in 2023. The driving force? New Energy Vehicles (NEVs) — electric vehicles (EVs), plug-in hybrids (PHEVs), and extended-range EVs (EREVs) that combine cutting-edge technology with competitive pricing.

BYD alone sold over 3 million NEVs in 2024, while brands like Geely, Great Wall, and Chery are rapidly expanding their international footprint. For importers in emerging markets, Chinese EVs offer an unbeatable combination of quality, range, and value.

Import Regulations by Country
Each destination has unique requirements. Here's what you need to know:
Georgia (FTA with China)

Georgia offers a Free Trade Agreement with China, meaning 0% import duty on EVs from Chinese manufacturers. A 5% customs fee applies to ICE vehicles. Left-hand drive is mandatory, and vehicles must meet Euro 5 emissions standards. Right-hand drive vehicles older than 15 years are prohibited.
UAE

The UAE imposes a standard 5% import duty on all vehicles. EV imports are growing rapidly, with Dubai and Abu Dhabi investing heavily in charging infrastructure. GCC homologation (GSO standards) is required for all imports.
Russia

Russia applies 15-25% import duties on vehicles, though Chinese brands benefit from favorable bilateral trade agreements. EAEU homologation (TR CU certification) is mandatory. Chinese EV sales in Russia grew 500%+ year-over-year in 2024.
Shipping Methods & Costs
There are three main shipping options for Chinese vehicle exports:

items: Roll-on/Roll-off (RoRo): The most cost-effective method for bulk shipments. Vehicles are driven onto specialized carriers. Cost: $800-1,500 per vehicle to major ports.
Container Shipping: Vehicles are loaded into 40ft containers (typically 2-3 cars per container). More flexible scheduling, slightly higher cost: $1,200-2,500 per vehicle.
Rail Freight (China-Europe Railway): Growing in popularity for Central Asian and Russian destinations. Transit time: 15-20 days vs. 30-45 days by sea.

仅比亚迪在2024年就销售了超过300万辆新能源汽车，而吉利、长城和奇瑞等品牌正在迅速扩大其国际影响力。对于新兴市场的进口商来说，中国电动汽车提供了质量、续航和价值的无与伦比的组合。

ru.text: Почему китайские электромобили доминируют на мировых рынках

Китай стал крупнейшим в мире экспортером автомобилей, обогнав Японию в 2023 году. Движущая сила? Транспортные средства на новой энергии (NEV) — электромобили (EV), подзаряжаемые гибриды (PHEV) и электромобили с увеличенным запасом хода (EREV).
Только BYD продала более 3 миллионов NEV в 2024 году, в то время как такие бренды, как Geely, Great Wall и Chery, быстро расширяют свое международное присутствие.

en.text: China's Lingerie Manufacturing Clusters
China's intimate apparel industry is concentrated in several key manufacturing clusters, each with its own strengths:

items: Shantou (Guangdong): The largest lingerie manufacturing base in China, known for lace and seamless underwear. Home to brands like Cosmo Lady and Maniform. Over 2,000 factories with 30+ years of experience.
Zhongshan (Guangdong): Specializes in mid-to-high-end bra manufacturing with strong OEM capabilities. Many factories here supply European and American brands.
Yiwu (Zhejiang): Known for cost-effective seamless products and high-volume production. Ideal for budget-conscious buyers.
Qingdao (Shandong): Growing hub for sports lingerie and activewear, with proximity to northern China textile supply chains.

en.text: Understanding MOQ: Minimum Order Quantities
MOQ is one of the biggest challenges for new importers. Here's what to expect:
Quality Control Checklist

items: Fabric composition verification (cotton/polyamide/spandex ratios)
Color fastness testing (wash and rub tests)
Stitch quality inspection (stitches per inch, seam strength)
Size accuracy measurement (±1cm tolerance)
Elastic durability test (stretch recovery after 100 cycles)
Label and packaging compliance (care labels, barcodes)

en.text: Shipping & Logistics

Sea Freight (LCL): $80-150/CBM, 25-35 days

en.text: The Chinese Security Equipment Market

China dominates the global security equipment market, accounting for over 50% of worldwide CCTV camera production. Hikvision and Dahua are the world's top two video surveillance manufacturers, while hundreds of specialized factories produce access control systems, alarm equipment, and tactical gear.
Top Product Categories

items: CCTV/IP Cameras: Bullet, dome, PTZ, and thermal cameras ranging from $15-500/unit depending on resolution and features.
NVR/DVR Systems: Network video recorders with 4-64 channels. Support H.265 encoding, AI analytics, and cloud storage.
Access Control: RFID card readers, biometric scanners, door controllers, and turnstils for commercial and industrial use.
Alarm Systems: Intrusion detection, fire alarms, and emergency response systems for homes, offices, and warehouses.
Tactical Equipment: Body armor, tactical vests, flashlights, and communication gear for security personnel.

en.text: Certification Requirements
UNGM Bidding Opportunities

The United Nations Global Marketplace (UNGM) is an excellent channel for security equipment exporters. UN agencies regularly procure CCTV systems, access control, and surveillance equipment for peacekeeping missions, refugee camps, and field offices. Chinese manufacturers with CE certification are well-positioned to win these contracts.
Why Import from China

items: Price advantage: Chinese security equipment costs 30-60% less than Western equivalents with comparable specifications.
Technology leadership: AI-powered analytics, facial recognition, and thermal imaging are standard features.
Scalability: From single-camera setups to city-wide surveillance systems, Chinese manufacturers offer complete solutions.
Fast delivery: Most products ship within 7-15 days of order confirmation.

excerptRu: Не попадайтесь на мошенничество. Узнайте, как проверить китайских производителей.

en.text: Step 1: Check Business License

Every legitimate Chinese company has a Unified Social Credit Code (USCC). You can verify it on the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (gsxt.gov.cn). Look for: company name matches, business scope includes your product category, and the license is still valid.
Step 2: Request Factory Photos & Video

A genuine manufacturer will gladly share photos and live video of their factory floor, warehouse, and quality control area. Be wary of suppliers who only have office photos or refuse to show production facilities.
Step 3: Third-Party Inspection

Services like SGS, Bureau Veritas, or local inspection companies can conduct factory audits on your behalf. Cost: $300-800 per audit. This is the most reliable way to verify production capacity and quality control systems.
Step 4: Secure Payment Methods

items: Alibaba Trade Assurance: Protects orders up to $100,000 with escrow payment.
Letter of Credit (L/C): Bank-guaranteed payment for orders over $10,000.
30% T/T + 70% against B/L copy: Standard practice for established relationships.
PayPal/Western Union: Only for samples, never for bulk orders.

zh.text: 每家正规中国公司都有统一社会信用代码。你可以在国家企业信用信息公示系统（gsxt.gov.cn）上验证。注意：公司名称是否匹配、业务范围是否包括你的产品类别、执照是否仍然有效。

en.text: Shipping Routes from China to Georgia
There are three primary routes for getting goods from China to Georgia:

items: Sea Freight via Poti Port: China ports (Shanghai/Ningbo/Shenzhen) → Black Sea → Poti, Georgia. Transit: 30-45 days. Most cost-effective for bulk cargo.
Rail via Middle Corridor: China → Kazakhstan → Caspian Sea → Azerbaijan → Georgia. Transit: 18-25 days. Growing alternative to sea freight.
Air Freight: Direct or via Istanbul/Tbilisi Airport. Transit: 5-10 days. Best for high-value, time-sensitive cargo.

en.text: Cost Comparison
Customs Clearance in Georgia

Georgia has one of the most business-friendly customs regimes in the region. Required documents: commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, certificate of origin, and import declaration. Processing time: 1-3 business days for standard clearance.
